dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction of lateral width from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform dark slate-grey baseline throughout the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct light-colored 'V' or chevron-shaped mark is visible on the midline of the anterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A light-toned chevron-shaped mark located posterior to the blowhole.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a dark-pigmented circular recess on the anterior midline.
